svg.title: WHICH OPTION FITS THE DEPOT?
svg.desc: Decision flow for a 40-bus school depot needing about 4,000 kWh a day. If spare grid power times 12 overnight hours covers the need, managed charging fits (400 kW gives 4,800 kWh). Otherwise, if spare power times 24 hours covers it, a battery on the existing service fits (250 kW gives 6,000 kWh). Otherwise energy must be brought in (150 kW gives 3,600 kWh). Winter can double the need.
svg.text: Spare grid power at the site (kW)
Winter can double the need to about
8,000 kWh a day — then even the 400 kW
First-pass screen. Ignores battery round-trip losses,
existing site loads and charger power limits.
AXIVAI estimates. Need = 40 buses × 60 mi × 1.5 kWh/mi ÷ 90%.
